scope: Exploratory 0PN one-mouth and local material tests. Stationary wave-empty delayed-flare radius 1 at Q=0.25, prescribed coherent carrier, independently titrated internal fuel h per converted constituent. h is a hypothetical external preparation, not a calibrated parameter of the actual substrate. H=chi²(3−2chi), y=1−H. Flat-front h*=Q/(A 6 M n² delta), A=4 pi R³/3; n=1, M=5, delta=.04, kappa=.08. This follows by substituting the logistic profile in the contact-free planar order law and does not fit any holding force.
power: Integrated external supply hQ checked against the physical unweighted volume integral of −hn H′ D_t chi. Fuel h n H produces no independent bulk force at constant h: its conservative contributions from order and particle density cancel. At stationary zero bend the power on the prescribed carrier from the bare order equals hR−(D_t chi)²/M. Constituent and order energy sources for the underlying undriven system are open. Do not interpret an assigned operating head as a newly derived energy store. Weak-bend contact heat and work must not simply be added to a straight-state precision balance; reciprocal flow changes and angular order corrections enter the total budget at quadratic order.
geometry: Coordinate w is retained through the throat; round reference uses exact S² angular integration. Numerical fixed-intake chemical titration relaxes meridional order. Positive meridional Hessian provides incoming branch selection. Independently continue via wall half-order depth as unknown h is solved with zero residual on every free node. Negative Rayleigh quotient on the returned branch proves a negative meridional direction. The fold is local to this preparation.
reference: Mean spring E=k chi |s−p|²/2. Existing rate D_t p=(s−p)/tau. Signed power into its stiffness from changing order is (k/2)|s−p|²D_t chi. Kinematic material slip and carried mean energy are separately metered. Reaction +t on material and −t on wall, t=k chi(s−p); the interior segment force is not the generalized force of the whole mouth. Signed net deep holder reported by code contains only this contact and neutral carrier; bare order, other wall terms and applied supports are separate. Positive difference in negative gate work does not demonstrate delivery into the spring.
alternative: Trial D_t p=g/tau−beta g D_t y, g=s−p. A chemical load beta t·g per unit converted fraction must be charged to conversion. Variation of the total order work adds the wall contribution k|g|²(1/2−beta chi H′). With monotone conversion, beta>9/16 is necessary for local net work to be positive somewhere because max chi H′=8/9. Numerically solve the contact dipole with this change, and include the order-modulus work in net delivered power. Curved-mouth energy coefficients are per b² and force coefficients per b. Relaxation rates use the discrete linearized reference operator with steady inflow, fixed carrier and fixed order. Positive rates are not a full coupled stability or free-release result. Local study uses arbitrary strengths for a constitutive law that could be measured by reference motion under opposite preloads at fixed slip. No material measurement of beta exists.
local_coupon: Fixed slip, stationary 4D straight-guide segment treated as uniform across radius; R=1, area per volume 3/R, chi endpoints .85 and .45, known shear preload, same intake. All powers are integrated, including both endpoint stress-work terms. Outlet extension over a prescribed conversion interval depends on beta, residence time and endpoint order; it need not increase further when h is varied. At +1% h* the chemical supply is the only net positive energy source after incoming spring energy is subtracted, including in the load comparison. At h* or below, the cut can supply energy instead. Terminal contact at chi=0 has zero spring energy at bounded extension. No inference about free acceleration from partial-path stored energy.
controls: Two meridional meshes, both inlet preparations of the passive wall, symmetrical full/half supply changes, signed shear-force check on two sides, independent characteristic integration, geometric and chemical power checks, additional shear subdivisions 3/4/5 near small whole-mouth sign crossing and explicit tests for growing reference modes. The surviving +5%-head, beta=5.425 fractions are numerical readings at specific subdivisions, not a continuum lower bound. Static p closure assumes a defined reference stream throughout. Original step-modulation script archived for its two original jobs; later version parameterizes the center and modulation amplitude.

"""Symmetric full/half supply perturbations at fixed carrier intake on a settled branch."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq

from mouth_carrier_lateral_response import prepare
from mouth_conversion_supply import SuppliedOrder
from mouth_empty_bend_stiffness import quadrature
from mouth_free_order_diffuse import read, section_geometry
from mouth_supplied_contact_work import verified
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import digest,emit


def main(a):
    records=verified(a.source)
    setup=next(r for r in records if r['test']=='calibration')
    center=next(r for r in records if r.get('multiple')==.5)
    dom,psi=prepare(SimpleNamespace(source=Path(records[0]['source']).parent))
    emit(**setup)
    if digest(Path(center['path']))!=center['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Starting state changed')
    with np.load(center['path']) as data:
        seed=data['chi']
    model=SuppliedOrder(dom,psi,setup['width'],setup['mobility'])
    _,_,dr,dw=quadrature(dom)
    f=dom.N@psi
    ur,uw=(np.imag(g@(psi-1)/f) for g in (dr,dw))
    for delta in (-.02,-.01,0.,.01,.02):
        multiple=.5+delta
        h=setup['flat_head']*multiple
        if delta:
            result=model.equilibrium(seed,h)
            if result is None:
                raise ArithmeticError('Modulated layer did not settle')
            order=result[0]
            path=a.out/f'order_{multiple:.5f}.npz'
            np.savez_compressed(path,chi=order)
        else:
            order,path=seed,Path(center['path'])
        c=(dom.N@order)/model.quad_sum
        cr,cw=dr@order,dw@order
        material_rate=ur*cr+uw*cw
        fuel_per_chi=h*model.density*6*c*(1-c)
        mu_bare=-material_rate/setup['mobility']-fuel_per_chi
        supply=-fuel_per_chi*material_rate
        heat=material_rate**2/setup['mobility']
        axial_force=mu_bare*cw
        material_power=mu_bare*material_rate
        wt=dom.weight
        volume_supply=wt@supply
        depth=brentq(lambda z:read(dom,order,section_geometry(dom,z)[0],z)[0]-.5,.52,2.)
        emit(test='supplied_order',head=h,multiple=multiple,path=str(path),sha256=digest(path),
             head_power=h*setup['intake'],volume_supply=volume_supply,passive_loss=wt@heat,
             wall_half_order_depth=depth,bare_force_on_carrier_w=wt@axial_force,
             bare_force_work_on_carrier=wt@material_power,
             positive_local_carrier_work=wt@np.maximum(material_power,0),
             negative_local_carrier_work=wt@np.minimum(material_power,0))
        if abs(wt@(heat+material_power-supply))>5e-12 or abs(volume_supply/(h*setup['intake'])-1)>.001:
            raise ArithmeticError('Fuel, heat and carrier-work balance failed')


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--source',type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
    main(p.parse_args())

"""Independent characteristic continuum integration of the driven order gate on a held weak bend."""
import argparse,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss
from scipy.linalg import solve
sys.path.insert(0,'software/stage1_solver/tools')
from mouth_bend_renewal import volume_cost
from mouth_bend_static_shear import archive_inputs
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import digest

def check(mesh,sub,segments,supply_dir):
    root=Path('_scratch/s11c')
    out=json.loads((supply_dir/'outcome.json').read_text())
    limits=json.loads((supply_dir/'limit-validation.json').read_text())
    assert out['limitsVerified'] and not out['exitCode'] and not out['childOutcome']['exitCode'] and limits['verified'] and int(limits['actual']['memory.swap.max'])==0
    rows=[json.loads(t) for t in (supply_dir/'stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
    case=next(d for d in rows if d.get('test')=='calibration')
    assert case['mesh']==mesh and abs(case['intake']-.25)<2e-8
    geo,base,carrier=archive_inputs(root/f'mouth_free_order_delayed_n{mesh}_d04/order_seed1.55.npz',root/f'bend_static_shear_delcarrier{mesh}_01')
    dep,rad,cells=geo.order_blocks[2]
    wallnodes=cells[::len(rad)-1][:,[0,3,6]]
    psi_source=root/f'mouth_flared_delayed_n{mesh}/field.npz'
    assert digest(psi_source)==rows[0]['sha256']
    with np.load(psi_source) as data: psi=data['psi']
    def walltrace(field,z):
        i=np.clip(dep.searchsorted(z,side='right')-1,0,len(dep)-2)
        h=np.diff(dep)[i]
        mid=(z-dep[i])/h
        a,b,c=np.moveaxis(field[wallnodes[i]],-1,0)
        l=4*b-3*a-c
        q=2*(a+c-2*b)
        return a+mid*(l+mid*q),(l+2*mid*q)/h
    def vz_at(z):
        f,df=walltrace(psi,z)
        return (df/f).imag/(1+geo.radius(z)[1]**2)
    # Integrate to the physical clock endpoint, even if the order-supported wall is shorter.
    gl,gw=leggauss(10)
    times=np.r_[dep[(dep>=.5)&(dep<2)],2.]
    dq=np.diff(times)[:,None]
    tau=np.sum(gw*dq/(2*vz_at(times[:-1,None]+dq*(gl+1)/2)))
    ys,w=leggauss(8); y2=ys**2
    for row in [x for x in rows if x.get('test')=='supplied_order']:
        path=Path(row['path']);assert digest(path)==row['sha256']
        with np.load(path) as file: chi_field=file['chi']
        edges,keep,bulk=volume_cost(geo,chi_field,sub,4,1e-9)
        count=np.flatnonzero(keep)[-1]+1
        basis=np.eye(len(edges))[:,keep]
        dz=np.repeat(np.diff(edges)[:count]/segments,segments)
        idx=np.repeat(np.arange(count),segments)
        eta=np.tile((np.arange(segments)+.5)/segments,count)
        z=edges[idx]+np.diff(edges)[idx]*eta
        r,rp=geo.radius(z); arc=np.hypot(1,rp); vz=vz_at(z)
        chi,dchi=walltrace(chi_field,z)
        if np.min(chi)<=0: raise ValueError('Active wall contains nonpositive order')
        val=(1-eta[:,None])*basis[idx]+eta[:,None]*basis[idx+1]
        grad=(basis[idx+1]-basis[idx])/np.diff(edges)[idx,None]
        ext_m=val/(chi*r*r)[:,None]
        ext_a=grad/(2*chi*r*arc)[:,None]
        def memorize(ext):
            dw=ext*(dz/(tau*vz))[:,None]
            return np.cumsum(dw,axis=0)-dw/2
        operator=bulk+ val.T@((dz*arc)[:,None]*(ext_m+memorize(ext_m)))+grad.T@((dz*r)[:,None]*(ext_a+memorize(ext_a)))
        t=np.clip((z-1.2)/.8,0,1)
        shape=t**3*(10+t*(-15+6*t))
        load=val.T@(dz*r*(-30/.8)*t**2*(1-t)**2)
        m=solve(operator,load,assume_a='gen')
        offset=solve(operator,grad.T@(dz*r),assume_a='gen')
        for inlet,state in [('straight',m),('relaxed',m-(m[0]/offset[0])*offset)]:
            em,ea=ext_m@state,ext_a@state
            e2=em[:,None]**2*y2+ea[:,None]**2*(1-y2)
            area=2*np.pi*(dz*r*r*arc)[:,None]*w
            transfer=.5*e2*(dchi*vz)[:,None]
            renewal=chi[:,None]*e2/tau
            material_x=chi[:,None]*(em[:,None]*(rp/arc)[:,None]*y2+ea[:,None]*(1-y2))
            diag={}
            for b in (.01,-.01,.005):
                rule=area*b*b
                spring_work=float(np.sum(rule*transfer))
                loss=float(np.sum(rule*renewal))
                f=float(np.sum(area*b*shape[:,None]*material_x))
                rootmode=(4*np.pi/3)*float(load@state)*b
                if abs(f-rootmode)>2e-8: raise ArithmeticError('shape/traction disagreement')
                print(json.dumps(dict(mesh=mesh,sub=sub,segments=segments,bend=b,inlet=inlet,
                        level=row['multiple'],head=row['head'],input_power=row['head_power'],
                        order_to_springs=spring_work,positive_transfer=float(np.sum(rule*np.maximum(transfer,0))),
                        loss=loss,conditional_deep_contact_on_material=f,conditional_deep_contact_on_wall=-f,
                        conditional_deep_holder=f+b*carrier[1,1],full_wall_contact_on_material=float(np.sum(area*b*material_x)),tau=tau)),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--mesh',type=int,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--sub',type=int,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--segments',type=int,default=32)
    p.add_argument('supply',type=Path)
    a=p.parse_args();check(a.mesh,a.sub,a.segments,a.supply)

"""Independent rest-length stroke in a traveling contact characteristic. Input and output use signed work."""
import argparse,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss
from scipy.linalg import solve
sys.path.insert(0,'software/stage1_solver/tools')
from mouth_bend_renewal import volume_cost
from mouth_bend_static_shear import archive_inputs
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import digest

def check(mesh,sub,segments,supply_dir):
    root=Path('_scratch/s11c')
    out=json.loads((supply_dir/'outcome.json').read_text())
    limits=json.loads((supply_dir/'limit-validation.json').read_text())
    assert out['limitsVerified'] and not out['exitCode'] and not out['childOutcome']['exitCode'] and limits['verified'] and int(limits['actual']['memory.swap.max'])==0
    rows=[json.loads(t) for t in (supply_dir/'stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
    case=next(d for d in rows if d.get('test')=='calibration')
    assert case['mesh']==mesh and abs(case['intake']-.25)<2e-8
    geo,base,carrier=archive_inputs(root/f'mouth_free_order_delayed_n{mesh}_d04/order_seed1.55.npz',root/f'bend_static_shear_delcarrier{mesh}_01')
    dep,rad,cells=geo.order_blocks[2]
    wallnodes=cells[::len(rad)-1][:,[0,3,6]]
    psi_source=root/f'mouth_flared_delayed_n{mesh}/field.npz'
    assert digest(psi_source)==rows[0]['sha256']
    with np.load(psi_source) as data: psi=data['psi']
    def walltrace(field,z):
        i=np.clip(dep.searchsorted(z,side='right')-1,0,len(dep)-2)
        h=np.diff(dep)[i]
        mid=(z-dep[i])/h
        a,b,c=np.moveaxis(field[wallnodes[i]],-1,0)
        l=4*b-3*a-c
        q=2*(a+c-2*b)
        return a+mid*(l+mid*q),(l+2*mid*q)/h
    def vz_at(z):
        f,df=walltrace(psi,z)
        return (df/f).imag/(1+geo.radius(z)[1]**2)
    # Integrate to the physical clock endpoint, even if the order-supported wall is shorter.
    gl,gw=leggauss(10)
    times=np.r_[dep[(dep>=.5)&(dep<2)],2.]
    dq=np.diff(times)[:,None]
    tau=np.sum(gw*dq/(2*vz_at(times[:-1,None]+dq*(gl+1)/2)))
    ys,w=leggauss(8); y2=ys**2
    for row in [x for x in rows if x.get('test')=='supplied_order' and x['multiple'] in (0.,.05,.1,.2,.5,.8)]:
        path=Path(row['path']);assert digest(path)==row['sha256']
        with np.load(path) as file: chi_field=file['chi']
        edges,keep,bulk=volume_cost(geo,chi_field,sub,4,1e-9)
        count=np.flatnonzero(keep)[-1]+1
        basis=np.eye(len(edges))[:,keep]
        dz=np.repeat(np.diff(edges)[:count]/segments,segments)
        idx=np.repeat(np.arange(count),segments)
        eta=np.tile((np.arange(segments)+.5)/segments,count)
        z=edges[idx]+np.diff(edges)[idx]*eta
        r,rp=geo.radius(z); arc=np.hypot(1,rp); vz=vz_at(z)
        chi,dchi=walltrace(chi_field,z)
        if np.min(chi)<=0: raise ValueError('Active wall contains nonpositive order')
        val=(1-eta[:,None])*basis[idx]+eta[:,None]*basis[idx+1]
        grad=(basis[idx+1]-basis[idx])/np.diff(edges)[idx,None]
        ext_m=val/(chi*r*r)[:,None]
        ext_a=grad/(2*chi*r*arc)[:,None]
        ydot=-6*chi*(1-chi)*dchi*vz
        t=np.clip((z-1.2)/.8,0,1)
        shape=t**3*(10+t*(-15+6*t))
        load=val.T@(dz*r*(-30/.8)*t**2*(1-t)**2)
        for beta in (5.,5.25,5.5,6.,8.,12.,16.):
            def history(ext):
                increment=ext*((1/tau-beta*ydot)*dz/vz)[:,None]
                return np.cumsum(increment,axis=0)-increment/2
            operator=bulk+ val.T@((dz*arc)[:,None]*(ext_m+history(ext_m)))+grad.T@((dz*r)[:,None]*(ext_a+history(ext_a)))
            state=solve(operator,load,assume_a='gen')
            em,ea=ext_m@state,ext_a@state
            e2=em[:,None]**2*y2+ea[:,None]**2*(1-y2)
            area=2*np.pi*(dz*r*r*arc)[:,None]*w
            soft=np.sum(area*.5*e2*(dchi*vz)[:,None])
            stroke=beta*np.sum(area*chi[:,None]*e2*ydot[:,None])
            heat=np.sum(area*chi[:,None]*e2/tau)
            material_x=chi[:,None]*(em[:,None]*(rp/arc)[:,None]*y2+ea[:,None]*(1-y2))
            generalized=float(np.sum(area*shape[:,None]*material_x))
            # Read back reaction from χ, including modulus and intrinsic stroke.
            rate_spring=np.sum(area*(.5-beta*chi[:,None]*6*chi[:,None]*(1-chi[:,None]))*e2*(dchi*vz)[:,None])
            assert np.isclose(rate_spring,soft+stroke,rtol=1e-11,atol=1e-12)
            print(json.dumps(dict(mesh=mesh,sub=sub,segments=segments,level=row['multiple'],
                                  head=row['head'],beta=beta,stroke=stroke,soft=soft,heat=heat,
                                  net_per_renewal=(soft+stroke)/heat,total_deep_holder=generalized+carrier[1,1],
                                  two_way_order_backload_power=-rate_spring)),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--mesh',type=int,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--sub',type=int,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--segments',type=int,default=32)
    p.add_argument('supply',type=Path)
    a=p.parse_args();check(a.mesh,a.sub,a.segments,a.supply)

"""Stationary planar 0PN conversion patch with fixed endpoint states and measured work.
All extensive readouts are per unit cross-section. Passive contacts of specific
area alpha are continuously swept along an imposed weak slip profile. A third
equation advances their reference. Conversion acts back on the order field.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import solve_bvp, simpson
from scipy.special import expit
from sympy import Symbol, cancel, diff, expand, factor

def identities():
    x,n,h,k,z,p,u,m,tau= [Symbol(q,positive=True) for q in ('x','n','h','k','s','p','u','M','tau')]
    H=x*x*(3-2*x)
    xp=Symbol('xp',real=True)
    sp=Symbol('sp',real=True)
    g=k*(z-p)**2/2
    f=h*n*H
    e=x*g
    R=-n*H.diff(x)*u*xp
    mu=-(u*xp)/m -n*h*H.diff(x)-g
    identities={
        'chemical_body_force':(f.diff(x)-n*f.diff(n,x))*xp,
        'energy_slot':mu*u*xp + g*u*xp+(u*xp)**2/m-h*R,
        'contact_chain':e.diff(x)*u*xp+e.diff(z)*u*sp+e.diff(p)*(z-p)/tau -
              (g*u*xp+k*x*(z-p)*u*sp-k*x*(z-p)**2/tau)
    }
    assert all(factor(expr)==0 for expr in identities.values())
    print(json.dumps({'symbolic':{name:str(factor(expr)) for name,expr in identities.items()}}),flush=True)

def calc():
    # Same sigma, mobility, width and renewal time as the archived mouth.
    area,n,rate,delta,mobility,kappa,k,tau,alpha=1.,1.,.25,.04,5.,.08,1.,26.0591,1.
    u=rate/(n*area)
    L=12*delta
    hstar=u/(6*mobility*n*delta) # calibration on the contact-free infinite planar front
    mesh=np.linspace(0.,L,401)
    cm=expit(-(mesh-L/2)/delta)
    solve_grid=np.linspace(0.,L,2001)
    for b in (0.,.01,-.01,.005):
        slip=lambda z:b*np.sin(np.pi*z/L)**2
        slope=lambda z:np.pi*b/L*np.sin(2*np.pi*z/L)
        for fraction in (.99,.995,1.,1.005,1.01):
            h=hstar*fraction
            def fun(z,y):
                c,dc,p=y
                e=slip(z)-p
                well=kappa*c*(1-c)*(1-2*c)/delta**2
                # μ_bare=well−κχ'', q=−M(μ_bare+α k e²/2+ nh H')
                return np.stack([dc,(u*dc/mobility+well+alpha*k*e**2/2+n*h*6*c*(1-c))/kappa,e/(u*tau)])
            def bc(a,b):
                return np.array([a[0]-1,b[0],a[2]])
            result=solve_bvp(fun,bc,mesh,np.stack([cm,-cm*(1-cm)/delta,np.zeros_like(cm)]),tol=2e-9,max_nodes=15000)
            if result.status:raise ValueError(result.message)
            z=solve_grid
            c,dc,p=result.sol(z)
            e=slip(z)-p
            q=u*dc
            t=k*c*e
            order_to_contact=alpha*k*e**2/2*q
            renewal=alpha*t*e/tau
            entry_exit=alpha*u*(.5*k*c[-1]*e[-1]**2-.5*k*c[0]*e[0]**2)
            slipwork=alpha*t*u*slope(z)
            integrate=lambda array:float(simpson(array,x=z))
            inport=integrate(-h*n*6*c*(1-c)*q)
            heat=integrate(q**2/mobility)
            transmitted=u*( -kappa/2*(dc[-1]**2-dc[0]**2) ) # bare capillary traction power across cuts
            force=integrate(alpha*t)
            gwork=integrate(order_to_contact)
            re=integrate(renewal)
            sw=integrate(slipwork)
            totals=dict(test='stationary_patch',h_rec=h/hstar,h_applied=h,rate=rate,bend=b,heat=heat,inport=inport,
                signed_order_to_contact=gwork,renewal=re,slip_work=sw,bare_axial_reaction_power=transmitted,
                axial_force_on_flow_from_bare_order=transmitted/u,transverse_force_on_material=force,
                opposite_force_on_rim=-force,branch_min=float(c.min()),branch_max=float(c.max()),max_dchi_dz=float(dc.max()),
                order_port_closure=inport-heat-transmitted-gwork,contact_balance=entry_exit-gwork-sw+re,
                spring_energy_out_minus_in=entry_exit,mesh_nodes=len(result.x))
            print(json.dumps(totals),flush=True)
            assert abs(inport-rate*h)<2e-11 and abs(totals['order_port_closure'])<2e-10 and abs(totals['contact_balance'])<2e-13
            assert dc.max()<0 and c.min()>-1e-11 and c.max()<1+1e-11
            assert gwork<=0 and re>=0
if __name__=='__main__':
    identities()
    calc()

"""Local passive transduction and pointwise necessary threshold for a proposed work stroke."""
import json
import sympy as s
c,l,k,g,xrate,A,Lc,Lp,q,chi_rate=s.symbols('c l k g xrate A Lc Lp q chi_rate',real=True)
t=k*c*g
H=c*c*(3-2*c)
load=l*t*g
R=Lc*(A-load)
p_dot=Lp*t-l*g*R
heat=Lp*t**2+R**2/Lc
entropy=s.factor(t*p_dot+A*R-heat)
generator=s.Matrix([[Lp+Lc*(l*g)**2,-Lc*l*g],[-Lc*l*g,Lc]])
assert entropy==0 and s.simplify(generator.det()-Lp*Lc)==0
predicate=c*s.diff(H,c)
candidates=[s.S.Zero,s.S.One]+s.solve(s.diff(predicate,c),c)
peak=max(predicate.subs(c,z) for z in candidates if 0<=z<=1)
threshold=s.S.Half/peak
power=(k*g*g*s.Rational(1,2)*chi_rate+load*xrate).subs(xrate,-s.diff(H,c)*chi_rate)
net=s.factor(power-k*g**2*chi_rate*(s.Rational(1,2)-l*predicate))
assert peak==s.Rational(8,9) and threshold==s.Rational(9,16) and net==0
print(json.dumps(dict(positive_heat_identity=str(entropy),symmetric_mobility_determinant=str(s.factor(generator.det())),
             net_order_contact_power=str(s.factor(power)),max_chi_derivative=str(peak),minimum_stroke_for_any_positive_transfer=str(threshold),net_power_residual=str(net))))
